scope_decision: Glacial v1 supports only the installed Windows x64 NSIS edition; the retired portable edition does not close any installed lifecycle or release requirement.

classification_changes.reason: G049 and G050 together document and natively verify exact installed paths, retention, reset, verified backup, manual restore, reinstall, both uninstall variants, and project-file preservation.
G050 observes bounded graceful, forced-parent, and controlled startup-failure cleanup with no orphan backend and no new visible console window.
G050 concurrently launches the installed application and observes one effective frontend, one visible window, one backend, and intact SQLite state.

G049 and G050 provide exact installed paths plus first-run, predecessor upgrade, reset, recovery, reinstall, both uninstall variants, and project-state preservation on the supported installed NSIS edition.
G051 publishes a verified GitHub private-vulnerability-reporting form, response ownership, acknowledgement and update targets, coordinated disclosure guidance, and a non-sensitive fallback.
G051 completes the task-oriented installed lifecycle guide and a deliberately context-restricted clean-reader walkthrough; G049 and G050 provide the corresponding installed execution evidence.

G051 publishes and checks one consolidated interpretation guide for findings, severity, evidence, coverage, review states, expectations, baselines, checkpoints, reports, briefs, packages, and the 100-finding handoff cap.
G051 publishes a source- and G050-derived environment matrix, but display resolution/scaling and a representative multi-environment final-candidate matrix remain untested.

G051 publishes and checks the privacy/network, private security, ordinary support, response, installed-upgrade, and compatibility policies; the owner confirms that intentionally intermittent icefields.dev HTTP availability is not a support blocker.
